question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a black ball, Bob has a blue ball, Claire has a grey ball, Dave has a orange ball, Eve has a white ball, Fred has a pink ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Finally, Dave and Fred swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) black ball
(B) blue ball
(C) grey ball
(D) orange ball
(E) white ball
(F) pink ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (black, blue, grey, orange, white, pink, gold).
1. Fred and Gertrude swap: (black, blue, grey, orange, white, gold, pink).
2. Eve and Fred swap: (black, blue, grey, orange, gold, white, pink).
3. Bob and Dave swap: (black, orange, grey, blue, gold, white, pink).
4. Claire and Fred swap: (black, orange, white, blue, gold, grey, pink).
5. Gertrude and Claire swap: (black, orange, pink, blue, gold, grey, white).
6. Eve and Bob swap: (black, gold, pink, blue, orange, grey, white).
7. Dave and Fred swap: (black, gold, pink, grey, orange, blue, white).
Eve has the orange ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
